verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents generated/official clients for its Inference API (Connect, gRPC, Protobuf) across Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Swift, plus a Terraform/OpenTofu provider — evidence of SDK-based, agentic-friendly integration. However, the pack lacks a dedicated SDK landing page, versioning/release cadence, code samples, or independent/hands-on confirmation of SDK quality. missing for 10: dedicated SDK docs/repo links, code examples or quickstarts, versioning and maintenance evidence, independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
